rules.title: Shorten showers by 3 minutes
rules.description: Cutting daily shower time by 3 minutes saves substantial water and water-heating energy.

rules.title: Reduce AC run time by 1 hour
rules.description: Using the air conditioner 1 hour less per day noticeably lowers daily electricity use.

rules.title: Reduce ceiling fan run time by 2 hours
rules.description: Turning off ceiling fans when rooms are unoccupied saves continuous baseline electricity.

rules.title: Reduce laptop active time by 1 hour
rules.description: Unplugging or sleeping personal devices when not in use trims computing power.

rules.title: Consolidate 1 laundry load per week
rules.description: Washing fuller loads saves both water and electric washing cycles.

rules.title: Switch to front-load washing
rules.description: Front-load washing machines use significantly less water per cycle compared to top-loaders.
